## ACCEPT · objectui#13037 · PR #13041 · `domain:ui#2` · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-19T11:24Z

PR #13041 at head `9fd11fb` (`Fixes #13037`), reviewed against the claim `6265071059` and the dev report `6265888055`.

- **Premise, measured: holds, with one fork resolved inside the ruling.** streamdown@2.5.0 does not export its default link component, the one that carries the dialog, so overriding `components.a` would replace handling for every link. The record form is intercepted instead through streamdown's own `linkSafety.onLinkCheck`, and only for that form.
- **The form (for objectstack-ai/cloud#3072's rule line):** `/record/OBJECT/ID`, matched against the WHOLE href by `^\/record\/([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128})$`. A query string, a fragment or an extra path fails the match: nothing is navigated, nothing is passed to the host, and the link keeps the default dialog.
- **Diff read by the seat:**
  - `src/recordLink.ts`, module-private: `parseRecordLink` and `withRecordLinks`. A matching href calls the host's `onOpenRecord({ objectName, recordId })`, the same `AiChatPage` opener the `open_record` card already uses, so there is no second copy of the app-segment and base resolution. It returns a never-settling promise so streamdown neither opens the dialog nor calls `window.open`.
  - Every other href goes to the caller's own check, or `false`, which is streamdown's dialog plus a new tab.
  - With no `onOpenRecord` (other hosts), the base config is returned unchanged.
  - `ChatbotEnhanced` provides `onOpenRecord` through a module-private context at the answer's `MessageResponse`. No new export, prop or i18n key.
- **Safety, checked by the seat in streamdown@2.5.0's dist:** `onLinkCheck` is called only inside the link's click handler, after `preventDefault`, never at render. Rendering an answer cannot navigate. The pending promise only parks that one click handler; no component state changes. The link-safety dialog stays in force for every external and arbitrary same-origin link, per the card's precedent objectui#12493.
- **Clause-②: no.** A rendered-link convention inside the chat. Changeset `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot: patch`.
- **Accepted deviations:** the helper sits at `src/recordLink.ts`, not under `elements/` (`spec-symbol-batch6` keeps that directory vendored-only). One test-only app-shell file, `AiChatPage.recordLink-13037.test.tsx`, uses the host's real opener; `AiChatPage.tsx` is unchanged.
- **Pins:**
  - (a) a record-form link navigates in the same tab with no dialog, under a `/_console` and a root `BrowserRouter` basename, end to end through `AiChatPage`;
  - (b) an external link and an arbitrary same-origin path in the same answer still open the dialog;
  - (c) the form with a query string, fragment or extra path neither navigates nor passes anything;
  - a grammar unit.

  Three ablations (interception removed, end anchor removed, non-record links allowed), each red as expected; each restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Local gates (dev report):** `packages/plugin-chatbot/` plus the app-shell test, 78 files / 769 tests; `plugin-chatbot` + `app-shell` type-check 0; eslint 0 errors; the pre-tsc battery and the changeset checks all 0. The full `packages/app-shell/` dir is declared to CI.
- **Commits:** trailers are model-free. The PR went through the fleet-write relay.
- **Acceptance note:** hosts other than `AiChatPage` / `ChatPane` (e.g. the floating chatbot) pass no `onOpenRecord`. There the form keeps the default dialog and opens a tab where nothing serves `/record/...`, the same as every link there today.
- **Serial note:** PR #13040 (objectui#13038) also edits `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, a different region; whichever lands second takes the queue's merge.
- **CI at head:** 36/36 check-runs success or skipped on `9fd11fb` (filter=latest), `mergeable_state` clean.

Verdict: **ACCEPT**. The seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge; the merge queue lands it. objectstack-ai/cloud#3072 can add its `/record/OBJECT/ID` rule line once cloud's `.objectui-sha` carries this merge.
